title: [L3LS] Asymmetric traffic — dc1-spine2 underutilized
symptom: Monitoring shows dc1-spine2 carrying significantly less traffic than dc1-spine1. No alarms. Leaf nodes show both spines as BGP neighbors. Triage using L3LS orchestrator.
root_cause: maximum-paths set to 1 under router bgp 65100 on dc1-spine2 — ECMP disabled, only single path installed
